The existing electrical power distribution system remained unchanged, aimed at ensuring proper power distribution, lighting and data connectivity within the renovated space. New plumbing installations were carried out as specified in the plans, including the breakroom and air handling unit area. A new air handling unit was installed in the space, and the air duct was routed through the roof to connect to the new condensing unit on the rooftop creating a new replacement split system. New data outlets were installed in the partition walls, ensuring convenient access to data connections throughout the renovated space. Milestone 2.1: MEP and HVAC Installations This milestone represents the final stage of MEP and HVAC equipment installations. There is working power distribution, lighting and data connectivity, plumbing and HVAC with a new air handling unit within the renovated space. Deliverable 2.1: MEP and HVAC Installations The start of the project was delayed. Time was spent determining the most suitable process for Facilities Management to access funds. Second, the University closed during winter break and personnel were given set holidays as paid leave. Construction and renovation were conducted by a General Contractor. University policy required three official bid submissions. The three bids were received in Q1, and the General contractor selected started the work in Q2. MEP and HVAC was completed during Q2, and the project followed a revised schedule submitted at the end of Q1. Task 3: Construction, Flooring and Finishing The Construction, Flooring and Finishing task included erecting new partition walls, integrating the mechanical, electrical and plumbing patches, applying multiple coats of paint, installing the specified acoustic ceiling grid, installing carpet tile and lab flooring, refinishing existing doors and fitting stainless steel corner guards at all exterior corners. The phase included the provision and installation of new plastic laminate millwork in the lab and breakroom. Additionally, new metal casework was provided and installed, complete with integral resin tops and lighting, power and data provisions. New wall shelving with metal shelving was provided and installed. The completion of these tasks contributes to the overall aesthetics, functionality and durability of the renovated space. Milestone 3.1: Construction and Installation This milestone represents the final stage of the construction and installation of walls, millwork and fixtures, painting and wall finishing. The result was completed infrastructure in the renovated spaces. Deliverable 3.1 Construction and Installation Work toward this milestone began in April and was completed by the end of June. Construction and installation of infrastructure was completed during Q3. Milestone 3.2: Construction and Installation This milestone represents the final stage of the installation of the acoustic ceiling grid, carpet tile and lab flooring, refinished existing doors and fitted stainless steel corner guards at all exterior corners. Aspects of the spaces were prepped for final inspection and commissioning.
